summary: Backend, web and iOS tests written and run; all new tests pass, and every remaining failure also fails on unmodified origin/main (c01ab7eb) or is an environment gap. Nothing pushed or deployed.

backend.new_test_file: api/tests/test_profiles.py (107 checks, pass). Covers: bio validation (NFC, whitespace collapse, zero-width/bidi strip, 160 ok / 161 rejected not truncated, links/emails/tags/NFKC-folded links, combining-mark stacks, content filter), config validation (shipped config good; 6 bad variants rejected; check_profile_config wired into startup_checks), GET /profiles tiers (stranger no bio key, friend, self, unknown==malformed==blocked==suspended identical 404, suspended viewer 404), D1 accept-without-pending on POST /friends/{id}/add, legacy POST /message/add-friend and POST /profiles/{id}/friend-accept (404, no rows created) plus the with-pending success path, atomic accept (2 rows, request removed), wrong-party accept 404, D5 uniform request responses (real vs unknown vs existing friend vs blocked/suspended silent 204), D2/D4 allow-lists and email absence (/user/{id}, GET /friends/{id}, read_friend, /message/messages; no email string in any non-self response), stranger DM reads 404, bio edit IDOR 403, extra fields 422, terms 403, suspended 403, null clears, oversize 422, content filter 422 warm message, rate limits (distinct-profile sweep, friend request 20/hour then 429 shared across both entry routes, bio burst 3/min, outstanding cap, accept limit, generic 429 body), every /profile* route has an auth dependency and all four routes 401 unauthenticated, log capture (bio text, rejected bio text, link text never in any log record; PROFILE_AUDIT lines carry codes only), bio_admin.clear_bio and CLI arg check.

backend.full_suite: All 173 api/tests/test_*.py files run as plain scripts on private scratch Postgres 17 clusters (ports 55432 for tests that hard-require it and 55612 for a parallel half; both stopped and deleted afterwards; 5432 and other sessions' clusters never touched). After rerunning env-dependent files with a valid dummy APNs key and a fellowscript_backup database, every file passes except three: test_apns_config_validation (needs the machine-local AuthKey .p8 that is not in a worktree; fails identically on origin/main), test_backup (backup DB schema not provisioned in the scratch cluster; fails identically on origin/main), test_auth_hardening (3 'flag-off SQL parity vs HEAD' checks compare create_tables against git HEAD's db.py and see exactly one extra statement, the new ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN bio, because the work is uncommitted; proven by committing the same db.py and user_bio.py in a throwaway worktree where it passes 84/84; passes on origin/main 84/84). Expect it to pass after the commit.
backend.notes: test_profiles.py uses GITHUB_ACTIONS-compatible port handling only through the shared DBManager; it scopes its friend_requests deletes to its own users so it is safe next to other suites.

ios.first_compile_errors_in_profile_code: The first real xcodebuild compile of FellowScript/Profile/ failed with 13 errors, all one root cause in Profile/ProfileViewModel.swift: ProfileViewModel (ObservableObject, @Published) did not import Combine ('missing import of defining module Combine', 'does not conform to ObservableObject'). Fixed by adding 'import Combine' after 'import Foundation' (the only production-source change made by this gate). No other type errors in ProfileModels, ProfileView, ProfileHeaderView, ProfileActionsView, ProfileBioEditor, ProfileEntryViews, NetworkService+Profile or the edited ChatRootView/AccountView/AppState/MockDataService; no warnings from the new Profile sources. A test-side issue was also recorded: NetworkService.encodeURIComponent uses urlQueryAllowed so '/' and '?' in a target id pass through unescaped; ids are server-issued UUIDs and the server answers non-UUIDs with the uniform 404, so it is noted (low) not asserted.
ios.result: xcodebuild test (FellowScript-Test simulator, iOS 26.5, lock /private/tmp/claude-501/xcodebuild.lock taken and released each time, pgrep xcodebuild empty at acquisition): ProfileModelsTests 9/9, ProfileViewModelTests 33/33, NetworkServiceProfileTests 15/15, plus SubmenuVisualRedesignRegressionTests 21/21 (the AddFriendSheet source scans), AccountViewModelTests 1/1, AppStateAuthAccountTests 4/4: TEST SUCCEEDED.
ios.full_unit_bundle: A full FellowScriptTests run covered 337 of 338 test classes (2583 cases) before one nondeterministic hang in MessageThreadsViewModelTests (simulator clone idle at 0% CPU for 11 minutes; I stopped my own xcodebuild). Failures seen: 23 tests in 9 classes (MessageGroupRowBaselineTests 8, PendingInviteStoreTests 5, AppStatePendingInviteTests 3, RingMembersSheetUIStateTests 2 which passed on rerun, and one each in AccountEventsLoadRegressionTests, ComposerDividerRemovalRegressionTests, HeaderAvatarBloomRemovalRegressionTests, PullToRefreshWiringSourceTests, SenderGroupDividerRemovalRegressionTests). A targeted rerun of those classes plus MessageThreadsViewModelTests and StoreKitManagerPurchaseSyncFailureTests in BOTH the profiles tree and a clean origin/main worktree produced the identical set of 23 failing test names (diff empty), so none is caused by this task (Keychain-in-simulator, baseline label and source-scan drift on main). The hung MessageThreadsViewModelTests test passed on the rerun.

The 44pt friend-request avatar tap frame change noted by the frontend gate remains unverified by a UI test.

not_covered_or_residual: No automated test for the iPad compact-row avatar tap inside a Button label (frontend-ios noted it as unverified); the menu 'View profile' path is the reliable one.
Legacy GET /user/{id} does not 404 for blocked or suspended users (approved fallback); test_profiles asserts the allow-list shape and 200 for that case on purpose.
Accept/block race can leave a friend row for a blocked pair (documented); read paths re-check blocks and are covered by the block tests.
Rate limits use in-memory storage (per process); tests reset the limiter between sections.
Web 'hard reload on a /profile URL inside the Tauri desktop shell' redirect (Rust exact-match) is not testable here.
